feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 30 August 2026 3:41pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 30 August 2026 at 3:40pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Occasional strong winds later.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure centred off the west coast of Ireland tracks eastwards, bringing various frontal troughs across the area.


##Wind##

South or Southeast 3 to 5, becoming Cyclonic for a time this evening, then settling West or Northwest 4 or 5 occasionally 6 tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Showers, heavy at times with a risk of thunder, becoming mainly fair this evening. Isolated showers then develop again for a time tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or Northwest 4 or 5 occasionally 6, decreasing West 4 or 5 tomorrow evening, then backing Southwest overnight into Tuesday.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
